sections.title: Complex Partnership Concept
sections.content: Level 3 questions are multi-step and complex. Partners may change capital during the year, a new partner may join, some partners may withdraw capital, or a part of profit may be given as salary/commission. Final profit is shared in the ratio of effective (Capital × Time).

sections.title: Capital Change Problems
sections.content:
Example: Ajay invests ₹40000. After 6 months, he adds ₹20000.
First 6 months → 40000 × 6 = 240000
Next 6 months → 60000 × 6 = 360000
Total effective = 600000.
Vijay invests ₹50000 for 12 months → 50000 × 12 = 600000.
Ratio = 1:1

sections.title: Commission + Ratio Problems
sections.content:
If a partner gets 10% commission on profit, give him commission first, then share remaining profit in ratio.
Example: Total profit ₹100000, Ajay gets 10% commission = ₹10000. Remaining ₹90000 is shared in ratio.

sections.title: New Partner & Goodwill
sections.content:
If a new partner joins and gives goodwill, it is shared among old partners in their old ratio.
Example: Goodwill ₹30000, old ratio 2:1 → shares ₹20000 and ₹10000.

sections.title: Important Formulas
sections.content:
1. Effective Capital = sum of (different periods' capital × time).
2. Commission = Total Profit × Percentage.
3. Remaining Profit = Total Profit − Salary/Commission.
4. Final Share = (Person's effective share / Total effective share) × Remaining Profit.

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
1. Not dividing capital for different periods.
2. Subtracting commission incorrectly.
3. Sharing goodwill in wrong ratio.

sections.title: Quick Summary
sections.content: Level 3 partnership questions are multi-step. First apply special conditions (commission, salary, goodwill), then calculate each period's Capital × Time, form ratio, and finally share profit.

tricks.title: Split Time Periods Trick
tricks.explanation: When capital changes, calculate each period separately.

tricks.title: Deduct Commission First
tricks.explanation: Take commission percentage first and set aside.

tricks.title: Quick Multiplication
tricks.explanation: For 12 months, multiply directly, then simplify.

tricks.title: Equal Effective Capital Shortcut
tricks.explanation: If effective capitals are equal, profit is equal.

tricks.title: Goodwill Sharing Trick
tricks.explanation: Share goodwill among old partners in old ratio.

tricks.title: Simplify Large Numbers
tricks.explanation: Remove common factors from ratio to simplify.

tricks.title: One Part Shortcut
tricks.explanation: Divide remaining profit by total ratio to get one part.

tricks.title: Multi-Step Rule
tricks.explanation: Order: Commission/Salary → Effective Capital → Ratio → Share profit.
tricks.example: ₹120000 profit, deduct 10% commission first, then divide by ratio
